component.name: MediaLiner
component.summary: Browse and organize the photos in your folders

description.p: MediaLiner shows the photos in the folders you choose, where they are. There's no import and no database, and it never changes a photo.

ul.li: A tree of your folders and their subfolders
A grid of thumbnails, cached so folders open quickly
A preview with zoom, and stepping through a folder's photos
File details and EXIF data, with the location hidden until you ask
Merging one folder into another, never overwriting, with undo
